official.application_cycle: Applications open from Monday 24 August 2026; assessed on a rolling basis with scholarship offers made throughout the recruitment cycle until all allocations have been exhausted
official.status_note: The official page states applications open from Monday 24 August 2026 and that scholarships are limited; applications are reviewed on a rolling basis with offers made throughout the recruitment cycle until all allocations are exhausted.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship offers a 50% tuition fee reduction, applied to the Offer of Admission for the entire standard full-time duration of the eligible degree.
benefits: Scholarship applied to the Offer of Admission for the entire standard full-time duration of the eligible degree
eligibility: Be applying to study a CRICOS registered bachelor degree (minimum 96 units / 2 years equivalent) after the application of any credit/RPL, or a CRICOS registered master degree (minimum 72 units / 1.5 years equivalent) after the application of any credit/RPL, at Adelaide University
Undergraduate only: minimum ATAR of 99 (or international equivalent) in the qualification used as the basis of admission
Undergraduate and postgraduate: minimum overall Grade Point Average (GPA) of 6.7 (on a 7.0 scale) or comparable score in the qualification used as the basis of admission
Not be applying to study one of the Excluded Programs
Not be an Australia Awards recipient
Not be an International Sponsored Student entitled to a tuition fee waiver equal to or greater than the scholarship value
requirements: Maintain a minimum Program Term GPA of 5.5 on a 7.0 scale in each compulsory Study Period
A student cannot receive both this scholarship and a sponsor tuition fee waiver concurrently
Submit the completed scholarship application form together with the completed degree application
documents: Completed Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship Application Form (the dedicated SATAC version if applying via SATAC)
Completed degree application submitted together with the scholarship form
Full name as written on your passport or equivalent legal document, date of birth, and Education Agent details (if applicable) on the form
Written statement addressing extracurricular activities and how the scholarship will help you achieve your career goals
Evidence of ATAR 99 (or international equivalent) or an overall GPA of 6.7 on a 7.0 scale in the qualification used as the basis of admission
selection_criteria: Assessed by a selection panel based on merit
Limited places for students with a high distinction average
Applications reviewed on a rolling basis with offers made throughout the recruitment cycle until all allocations have been exhausted
coverage: 50% of tuition fees for the entire standard full-time duration of the eligible degree
application_method: Complete the appropriate Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship Application Form (standard or SATAC version)
Submit the completed form together with the completed degree application through one of Adelaide University's Education Agents or directly via the Online Application System
official.application_route: Download the official application form, complete it, and lodge it together with your degree application via an Adelaide University Education Agent or the Online Application System (SATAC applicants use the SATAC form).
official.study_mode: Full-time (standard full-time duration of the Coursework Program)
official.citizenship_residency: Open to international students only; Australia Awards recipients and International Sponsored Students entitled to a tuition fee waiver equal to or greater than the scholarship value are excluded
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scholarship is restricted to international students commencing an Adelaide University coursework degree
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Must not be applying to an Excluded Program, which includes the Bachelor of Dental Surgery, Bachelor of Medical Radiation Science, Bachelor of Medical Studies, Bachelor of Midwifery, Bachelor of Occupational Therapy, Bachelor of Physiotherapy, Bachelor of Podiatry, Bachelor of Science (Veterinary Bioscience), Bachelor of Speech Pathology, Doctor of Clinical Dentistry, Doctor of Medicine, Doctor of Veterinary Medicine, the Global Executive MBA (Defence and Space), all Master of Business Administration programs and specialisations, Master of Advanced Clinical Physiotherapy, Master of Counselling and Psychotherapy, graduate-entry nursing, midwifery, occupational therapy and physiotherapy, and the Master of Psychology programs
official.duration: Standard full-time duration of the recipient's undergraduate or postgraduate Coursework Program
official.description: The Adelaide Academic Excellence Scholarship recognises international students commencing undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degrees who have achieved outstanding academic performance in their previous studies. The University frames it as a prestigious, highly competitive award with limited places for students with a high distinction average, offering a 50% tuition fee reduction for the entire standard duration of eligible degrees.
official.english_requirement: The scholarship page sets no scholarship-specific English requirement. Adelaide University's general international entry requirement is a minimum IELTS Academic overall score of 6.0 or equivalent for undergraduate entry, with degree-specific English requirements potentially higher; accepted test results must be taken within two years prior to admission, and English-medium previous study or professional use of English may be accepted where certified documentation is provided.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a 50% tuition fee reduction, not a living stipend: you still fund the other half of tuition plus all living costs, flights and overseas student health cover yourself. Places are limited and awarded on a rolling basis from the 24 August 2026 opening, so lodging your scholarship form with your degree application early is the single biggest thing under your control. Holding the award is conditional on keeping a Program Term GPA of at least 5.5 in every compulsory study period, and a weak period can suspend the discount until your average recovers. Check the Excluded Programs list before you fall in love with a degree, because medicine, dentistry, veterinary, MBA and graduate-entry allied health programs are all shut out.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International students with a high distinction average (ATAR 99 or overall GPA 6.7/7.0) applying for a full Adelaide coursework degree outside the excluded clinical and MBA programs who can still fund roughly half their tuition and all living costs.
application_readiness_checklist: Screen your intended degree against the Excluded Programs list before applying
Confirm your qualification converts to at least 96 units (bachelor) or 72 units (master) after any credit or RPL
Obtain certified transcripts and a documented GPA or ATAR result showing 6.7/7.0 or 99
Download the correct application form (standard version, or the SATAC version if applying via SATAC)
Draft the extracurricular activities and career goals statement requested on the form
Book an IELTS or equivalent test with results valid within two years of admission
Build a realistic budget for the remaining 50% of tuition, living costs, OSHC and visa fees before committing
common_rejection_risks: Applying for one of the Excluded Programs (clinical health degrees, medicine, dentistry, veterinary, all MBA variants)
An admission GPA below 6.7 on a 7.0 scale, or an ATAR below 99 for undergraduate entry
A degree that falls under the 96-unit (bachelor) or 72-unit (master) threshold once credit/RPL is applied
Applying so late in the recruitment cycle that all allocations are already exhausted
Already holding a sponsor tuition fee waiver of equal or greater value, which makes you ineligible
Receiving the award and then dropping below a 5.5 Program Term GPA, triggering suspension
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 50% of tuition fees for the standard full-time duration of the degree, plus all living costs, overseas student health cover, student visa charges and flights. Adelaide University states applicants must be able to meet the cost of tuition and living expenses and that the University cannot waive tuition fees or pay living costs.
document_audit: There are two distinct forms - the standard form and a SATAC-specific version; using the wrong one for your application route stalls assessment
The form requires your full name exactly as written on your passport plus your date of birth, so any mismatch with your passport documentation will cause delay
Education Agent details are mandatory on the form if you applied through an agent
The written statement must specifically cover extracurricular activities and how the scholarship helps your career goals - a generic personal statement is not what the form asks for
English test evidence must be less than two years old at admission
alerts: Applications only open on 24 August 2026 - nothing is assessed before then
Assessment is rolling and stops when allocations run out, so there is effectively no guaranteed late deadline
The 5.5/7.0 Program Term GPA condition applies every single compulsory study period, not once at entry
Australia Awards recipients and sponsored students with an equal or larger fee waiver are excluded outright
No living-cost or travel money is included, so this scholarship alone will not satisfy Australian student visa financial capacity expectations
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the official scholarship application form, attach it to your completed degree application, lodge both through an Adelaide University Education Agent or the Online Application System (SATAC applicants use the dedicated SATAC form), then await rolling panel assessment and notification before commencement.
